events.title: PUNKT – program för unga
events.description: PUNKT är ett ungdomsbibliotek på Medborgarplatsen som riktar sig till dig 13-19 år. Vi finns en våning ovanför Tranströmerbiblioteket i Medborgarhuset (knapp 5 i hissen).

events.title: Jérôme Dubois - Imateriell
events.description: I samband med att Jérôme Dubois (FRA) avantgardistiska och färgsprakande serieroman Imateriell ges ut på svenska via Lystring förlag visas ett urval av originalteckningar i Serietekets lokaler. Under öppningskvällen den 1 september samtalar Jérôme Dubois om sitt arbete med serieforskaren Robert Aman.

events.title: Utställning: Ingemar Lundin
events.description:
Blackebergsbon Ingemar Lundin ställer ut oljemålningar och näverarbeten på Blackebergs bibliotek.

Ingemar Lundin är författare och konstnär och boende i Blackeberg sedan 1996.

Han har gett ut romanerna "Valhajen", "Frifoting" och "Rirs"

events.title: Konst på temat Frihet
events.description: Gabrielle van der Wal och Simone Hallin ställer ut sina verk under september månad..

events.title: Bokcirkel om 1700-talets Stockholm
events.description: Vi läser Ernst Brunners biografi “Darra om Swedenborg” om Emanuel Swedenborg (1688-1772), den kontroversielle vetenskapsmannen, bibeltolkaren, teosofen som blev internationellt känd för sina teologiska och andliga skrifter ock för sin banbrytande naturvetenskapliga forskning och sina tekniska innovationer långt före sin tid. Emanuel Swedenborgs liv rymmer en närmast unik dualitet – från exakt naturvetenskap till gränslösa andliga visioner.

events.title: Mangafestival
events.description:
Välkommen på mangafestival på Kista bibliotek!

Vi bjuder in till två fullspäckade veckor med roliga aktiviteter för dig som gillar manga och animé. Kom på workshop i mangateckning, lär dig japanska, pyssla med mangatema och lär dig mer om mangans spännande historia. Se fullständigt program nedan.

Under hela veckan kan du gå mangatipsrunda, pokémonjakt och delta i vårt läsbingo!

events.title: Utställning: Erik Jonasson
events.description: Erik Jonasson är bosatt i Farsta sedan 2020. Hans fotointresse började i slutet av 1990-talet, då han gick på konstskola och hade tillgång till fotolabb. Han fotar ofta tidigt på morgonen då gatorna är tomma och stadens puls ännu inte kommit igång. Alla foton som visas på Fanfaren är tagna i Farsta.

events.title: Head to toe
events.description:
Konsten vi har gjort  är personlig till var och en av oss. Några av våra teman är: könsidentitet, eufori/dysfori, mental ohälsa, autonomi samt många andra känslor/tankar, man får se för sig själv. 

Med konstnärerna Marta Guiyas Maliik, Isak Hoblyn Gunnarsson, Nikanor Sandoval och Yufan Zheng Yang.

events.title: Archipelago Midsummer boat ride
events.description: Join a 2.5-hour boat tour with Sightseeing Ride's famous guides. Sit back and enjoy Stockholm's world-famous archipelago. Taste traditional Swedish food and drinks while listening to stories about Sweden's somewhat peculiar traditions. How has the Stockholm archipelago affected life in the capital and why is Midsummer such a central part of our lives? Experience a true Swedish tradition. Restaurant and bar on board! Fun and relevant - The guides update their script every day.

venue.name: Bredvid Gustav III staty, Ship M/S Riddarholmen.

events.organizer: Bredvid Gustav III staty, Ship M/S Riddarholmen.

events.title: Forest – diversity or uniformity
events.description: Naturfotograferna tackle the big questions surrounding one of our most important natural heritage sites. Through photographs, texts and short films, visitors are given the opportunity to step into a world that appeals to both our imagination and our sense of playfulness. Here you’ll experience images from the most magical forests in our long, narrow country. But you’ll also encounter a different reality – one that raises questions about the state of the forest and how we manage it.

events.title: Beer Tasting Masterclass
events.description: Advanced beer tasting with guided tour. This experience includes a guided tour through the entire church, from the brewery to the atelier where all our labels are created. After the tour, you’ll enjoy a tasting of six carefully selected beers: both Omnipollo classics and more exclusive varieties such as sour beers and powerful stouts. An experience for anyone who wants a deeper insight into Omnipollo’s craft, environment, and the creative process behind every bottle. Duration: approx. 2 hours.

events.title: Sunset Hike in Tyresta National Park
events.description: Explore the real Sweden, its nature and wildlife on a guided sunset hike through Tyresta National Park. Experience ancient forests with still lakes and pine trees that are hundreds of years old. You meet late in the day in central Stockholm and go together out into the wilderness. The dusk and darkness is the best time to encounter wild animals like deer and wild bores.

events.title: Flatenbastun – Lakeside Sauna Experience
events.description: Flatenbastun offers a relaxed lakeside sauna experience by Lake Flaten in southern Stockholm. Here, warmth, nature and refreshing swims come together in a social and welcoming setting for both regulars and first-time guests. Open sauna sessions are available year-round and booked in advance via the website. Bring swimwear and towels for a genuine Swedish sauna experience close to nature.

venue.name: Flatenbastun
venue.district: Nearest bus stop: Flatenbadet (SL bus stop)

events.title: Guided Hike in Stockholm Nature Reserve + Campfire Lunch
events.description: Take a break from the hustle and bustle of Stockholm and immerse yourself in the serene surroundings of the Nacka Nature Reserve. Just a quick 20-minute drive from the city, this beautiful reserve is the perfect place to spend a day in nature. Enjoy a leisurely walk through the dense forests and over the high granite cliffs, taking in the views and fresh air. You will also be treated to a campfire-cooked lunch, adding an authentic touch to your experience.

events.title: Södermalms Full English Comedy Nights
events.description: Every Thursday, ComedyNation the best boutique comedy club proudly present Full English Standup Comedy, a tradition in Södermalm, Stockholm. This two-hour show offers a distinctive blend of comedy styles, showcasing local and English-speaking comedians who bring a variety of tastes and humor to the stage. To fully enjoy the evening, we recommend arriving by 18:00 to savor a meal and drinks at the Mariatorget Pitchers’ casino bar. 18+, door 18:00, show 19:00, limited number of seats.

events.title: Tanja Nyo & Jutta Himonas: DIALOGUES
events.description: A joint exhibition by painter Tanja Nyo and potter Jutta Himonas. Outside the visible world, organisms exchange nutrients and signals and support each other in subtle but vital ways. The exhibition deals with the microscopic life around us that we do not notice. It introduces new species that have lived quietly and undiscovered on our planet for billions of years.

events.title: Blowing Figures into Space
events.description: Blowing Figures into Space by the sculptor Davide Rivalta is a large-scale outdoor exhibition. It comprises twelve animal sculptures in bronze and aluminum, installed in symbolic locations, creating new perspectives on nature, power and coexistence. The sculptures are placed directly on the ground making them appear as if they have reclaimed the urban environment. Through this approach, Rivalta makes art accessible in public spaces and promotes dialogue across cultures. Guided tours each month.

events.title: Brassaï – The Secret Signs of Paris
events.description: Brassaï is one of the most famous photographers in history. In the early 1930s, he sets out with his camera on long nocturnal walks through Paris. The depictions of people and environments that emerge when darkness descends over the city become his breakthrough. The exhibition is the first major presentation of Brassaï in Sweden.

events.title: Lake Sauna by Mälaren at Kaggeholm Castle
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions in a lakeside sauna at Kaggeholm Castle on Ekerö. A booking covers one spot in the shared sauna. Mälaren sits directly outside for anyone wanting to plunge between rounds. Suits regulars and first timers alike. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: Eric Magassa - Rumble in the Jungle
events.description: Through his distinctive mixed-media language, Eric Magassa transforms the art gallery into a multisensory collage of sculpture, photography, a video series and textile works. At its center, a newly produced sculptural soundsystem pulses with music as both form and language, opening a deeply immersive direction in his practice. Rumble in the Jungle weaves family, archives, in-betweenness, urban/suburban friction and joyful ambiguity into an unruly, vibrant experience. Let the room tremble!

events.title: Time and Space for New Encounters: Hertha Hillfon X Vår Gård
events.description: Hertha Hillfon, one of the 20th century’s most radical and beloved sculptors, meets Villa Skärtofta. Here, her expressive works come closer—within a setting where art, architecture, and history interact. A unique experience offering a new way to see Hillfon’s work.

events.title: Martin Parr – Short & Sweet
events.description: Short & Sweet – just like the Swedish summer. The long-awaited major exhibition of works by Martin Parr finally opens at Fotografiska Stockholm, featuring nearly 400 works from his more than 50-year-long career. Visitors are invited to step into the legendary photographer’s distinctive visual world, filled with humorous glimpses of everyday life and sharp social satire.

events.title: Free Fridays at Moderna Museet
events.description: Start your weekend with art! Every Friday evening during the spring and autumn seasons, we offer free admission to the museum from 18.00 to 20.00. Visit Moderna Museet’s exhibitions for free between 18 and 20 on Fridays. During the period November 28 - April 5, an entrance ticket is required for the exhibition "Late Picasso".

events.title: Södermalm's Swedish Stand-up Comedy
events.description: Need a break from your everyday routine and a good laugh? We've gathered some of the best comedians for a night of unforgettable jokes and sharp observations. Our carefully curated comedy show is back, better than ever, with ticket options to suit every budget. We recommend arriving from 18:00 if you'd like to enjoy food and drinks before the show. Age limit: 18+. Doors open at 18:00. Show starts at 19:00.

events.title: Guided Tour in the Historical Food Hall Östermalms Saluhall
events.description: Newly renovated and more beautiful than ever. Östermalm's Saluhall re-opened its doors in 2020 after an extensive renovation. Book a guided tour in one of Stockholm's most beloved buildings. Your host is Lina Bielsten, founder of Östermalm's Saluhall Magasin (2010-2023). Lina presents the 135-year history of the market hall and architectural details, mixed with funny anecdotes from famous guests. A behind-the-scenes tour in which food samples can be added. Tours can be booked on request.

events.title: A World of Tales
events.description: Join us on a journey to the land of imagination in the exhibition A World of Tales. Here, children and their grown-ups can listen to stories from around the globe – myths, legends, creation tales, and fairy tales. Admission is free for everyone under 19.

events.title: The Metro - in step with the times
events.description: The Metro is much more than just a way of transportation, it is also an arena and an expression of society’s values, history and social dynamics. Welcome to the amazing world of the Metro and an exhibition that tells the story of the Stockholm Metro as a way of transportation and as a cultural phenomenon.

events.title: Crafts Exhibition 125 Kvadrat "Obygdsbroderier" with Emma Ewadotter
events.description: In Ewadotter’s textile works, embroidery becomes a space for movement between tradition and the contemporary, between the folk-inspired and the personal. The pieces bear traces of collecting, observing, and care—where color, sheen, and stitches build patterns that vibrate with intricate detail.

events.title: Pottery Painting
events.description: Pottery painting as it should be - MålaKeramik.se is a brand new concept with several studios in central Stockholm. Our ambition is to offer as many people as possible the chance to paint pottery in Stockholm in some of the capital's most beautiful environments. With a wide range items from cups and plates to vases and decorations, you can paint your own unique pottery and ceramics. Welcome to enjoy some analog quality time with us!

events.title: Ndidi Dike – Rare Earth Rare Justice
events.description: Färgfabriken is proud to present an exhibition by British-Nigerian artist Ndidi Dike. Rare Earth Rare Justice addresses questions of extraction and postcolonial structures while offering a powerful visual experience in Färgfabriken’s Main Hall.

events.title: Gold! 50 Years Together for Sweden
events.description: The display Gold! 50 years together for Sweden opens on 21 May in the State Apartments at the Royal Palace, featuring a historical retrospective of photographs, wedding gifts, clothing and objects that reflect The King and Queen's wedding in 1976 and five decades of shared history.

events.title: Freight – From Miniature to Mural
events.description: Swedish matchboxes are given new life as the artist collective NIZA transforms small labels into large-scale narratives, from the inside of the box to the walls of the city.

events.title: Exhibition: Samaneh Reyhani
events.description: Samaneh Reyhani is a Swedish-Iranian artist whose practice moves between the tangible and the poetic, with Persian cultural heritage forming a constant underlying current. Through sculpture and spatial compositions, she creates tactile, immersive environments in which historical references and contemporary experiences are interwoven.In this exhibition, Reyhani presents a cohesive body of new and earlier works, with an emphasis on large-scale installations and monumental sculptures.

events.title: The joyful world of Stig Lindberg
events.description: In the summer of 2026, the Porcelain Museum in Gustavsberg will open an exhibition about Stig Lindberg – one of Sweden's most beloved and versatile designers. Marking the 110th anniversary of his birth, you are invited into a colorful and playful world of design.

events.title: Halfday Fishing with fishing guide
events.description: Spend a full day fishing in the Stockholm Archipelago. This guided tour starts in Vaxholm and takes you by boat among islands, bays and rocky shores. We target pike, perch and, in colder seasons, sea trout with modern sport fishing gear adapted to season and weather. All experience levels are welcome but no experience needed, your guide is there for you. All equipment plus food and beverages included. Perfect for friends, families, couples or solo travellers wanting a memorable day.

events.title: Fredriksborg Fortress, history tour
events.description: Guided tours daily Jun-Aug, and weekends in May and September. Usually at 6 p.m. 95 SEK, or free for restaurant or hotel guests. Contact the hotel for reservation. You can also have lunch, fika or dinner at the restaurant and the hotel with two 1700s buildings has 15 charming rooms. Great view from the hotel, and even better from the roof top of the fortress. Watch the cruise ships passing by at the strait below or just enjoy the area.

events.title: In Bloom - Art & Botany
events.description: With spring as companion, Waldemarsudde open the doors to an exhibition where the flower’s significance in art, design, and cultural history is in full bloom. Here, painting, sculpture, textile art, photography, installations, and botanical illustrations from the 16th century to today meet — side by side with floral arrangements, both indoors and in the park. Welcome to experience Waldemarsudde in its most flourishing form.

events.title: Måla och Skåla (Sip and Paint)
events.description: Måla och Skåla (Sip and Paint) at Östgötagatan 16 or Rådmansgatan 49, both located in the city of Stockholm. Bring Your Own Beverge. The event ends with a mini art exhibition and a masterpiece to bring home!

events.title: Evening tour along quays and Skeppsholmen
events.description: Enjoy an evening walk through central Stockholm along waterfronts, parks and historic quays. Passing landmarks such as the Royal Dramatic Theatre, the National Museum, the Royal Palace and the Opera, you will discover the city's history, architecture and maritime heritage, including beautiful Skeppsholmen. The tour ends in Kungsträdgården, close to restaurants and cafés.

events.title: New exhibition at Spritmuseum about Absolut Vodka
events.description: Step into the story of Absolut Vodka, the Swedish brand that became a global icon through groundbreaking marketing. It’s a story of nostalgia, courage, creativity, and innovation, told through advertisements, bottles, art, and cocktails. The exhibition also features a cocktail machine where you can try classic drinks.

events.title: Consert & danceevening at Folkmusichouse!
events.description: Come and listen and dance to the legendary Hälsingland trio Draupner! One of the leading names in swedish folkmusic, Draupner has helped shape the modern folkmusicsound and made its mark on all folkmusicscenes in Sweden. Their concerts are intense and moving, with tradition meeting innovation in every note. Draupner has celebrated 30 years together, dedicated to the folkmusictradition of Hälsingland, and has received good reviews in the folkmusicmagazine Lira.

venue.name: Skeppsholmens folkhögskola/Föreningen Folkmusikhuset
venue.district: T-bana Blå: Kungsträdgården | Buss 65: Arkes/Moderna Museet | Buss 2: Karl XII's torg

events.title: Harvest Festival at Rosendals Trädgård
events.description: Rosendal’s Harvest Festival puts the garden’s harvest, food craftsmanship and healthy soil at the heart of the weekend. The market features freshly harvested biodynamic vegetables from Rosendal’s garden, wood-fired bread, fermented produce, preserves, cheese and other food products. There will also be pick-your-own flowers, children’s activities, guided tours, a beekeeper with an observation hive and the exhibition Bakom dina ögon.

events.title: The Hand That Tells, The Hand That Waters
events.description: Konsthall C is pleased to present Maxime Hourani’s first solo exhibition The Hand That Tells, The Hand That Waters, which features a film, handmade instruments, and an audio piece. In this newly produced work, he conjures sacred and profane apparitions encountered in the Sinai Peninsula of Egypt.

events.title: Postis!
events.description: With almost 400 objects in the postal history exhibition, POST welcomes visitors to an experiential and interactive exhibition that activates all the senses. Here you can follow the history of the post office from the 17th century until today. The exhibition highlights the hard work and both the people who made communication between people possible over five centuries and those who received mail. An exhibition for both adults and children.

events.title: Recurrence av Elin Fiorentino
events.description: Sergelgången is one of Sweden’s busiest pedestrian thoroughfares, with tens of thousands of people passing through every day. Now, The Node is launching On Screen – Art on the Move. This autumn, four artists will exhibit their work on our large LED screen, visible to everyone passing by outside. Because if people don’t come to the art, the art can come to the people. First up is video artist Elin Fiorentino with her work Recurrence. Exhibition runs until 20 September.

events.title: Open sauna and cold plunge in Riddersvik
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions by Mälaren in Hässelby, where the old orchard park slopes down to the water. Each session is open to anyone and a spot is booked in advance. Between rounds the jetty is a few steps across the grass. Sessions run year round, with the sharpest contrast in the winter months. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: Like share hate – An Exhibition on Antisemitism
events.description: How is our society affected by antisemitism and other forms of racism? And what can we do to stop it? In this exhibition, you will learn more about how to decode antisemitic messages and how your social media-feed is influenced by your behavior. You will also meet people who have been subjected to hate, both online and in real life. And you’ll get advice on how we can work against hatred.

events.title: Free Walking Tour Stockholm
events.description: Join our daily Free Walking Tour in the heart of Stockholm! Discover the city’s history, hidden gems, and coolest stories with passionate local guides. Tours run every single day, rain or shine, and are completely tip-based – you decide the value. The perfect way to explore Stockholm in a fun, social, and budget-friendly way! Find the exact times on our website.

venue.name: On the square in front of the Gamla Stan metro exit.
venue.district: Gamla Stan metro station, exit towards the Old Town.

events.organizer: On the square in front of the Gamla Stan metro exit.

events.title: Canoe Beaver Safari in the Stockholm Archipelago
events.description: Paddle through calm evening waters in Bogesund Nature Reserve on a guided canoe safari near Stockholm. Explore quiet inlets and forest-lined waterways while looking for beavers, coastal birds, and other wildlife active around sunset. The tour includes canoe equipment, fika, and an island-style outdoor dinner by the water. Suitable for beginners and families. Optional transfer from central Stockholm is available.

events.title: Slussen, Old Djurgårdsstaden & the Vasa Museum
events.description: From Slussen to Djurgården, discover Stockholm's maritime history and urban development. The walk begins where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea and continues to the historic wooden houses of Djurgårdsstaden. The tour ends with admission and a guided visit to the Vasa Museum, home to the famous warship that sank in 1628 and was salvaged more than 300 years later.

events.title: Jewish Värmland
events.description: What remains of a Jewish life when the synagogue has been demolished and traces in the city have almost disappeared? "Jewish Värmland" explores Jewish life in Karlstad and Värmland from the 19th century to today through photographs, archival material, objects, and personal testimonies. Produced with Värmlands Museum and previously presented in Karlstad, the exhibition is now shown in a new version in Stockholm.

events.title: Hooja – Grönan Live 2026
events.description: After nearly a year without performances, the masked duo from Gällivare returns with high-energy melodies, witty lyrics, and a brand-new stage production. On September 11, Hooja and Mårdis take the stage at Gröna Lund for a show that delivers the full package – don’t miss their creative and visually spectacular concert experience!

events.title: Södermalm's heights - city walk with a view
events.description: Join on a walk through Södermalm's historic heights, from Slussen to Medborgarplatsen. Strolling along Glasbruksgatan, Fiskargatan and Mosebacke, enjoy beautiful views and discover stories of people, places and transformation. Learn how Södermalm evolved from a working-class district into one of Stockholm's most creative and vibrant neighbourhoods.

events.title: Daily Stockholm bike tour
events.description: Experience Stockholm in a different way, on a comfortable bike with spectacular views. We pass the most iconic areas at a relaxed pace and take a nice break in the middle of the tour. This experience is for people from all over the world and also for 'Stockholmers'. A special Swedish-Dutch history tour is also offered. Tours are given at 9.30 and 13.30 every day.

events.title: Play and fun with En frisk generation!
events.description: En frisk generation is coming to Jan Stenbeck Square to run various activities and games. All activities and games focus on physical exercise, where they hope to get all children and young people involved to experience the joy of movement.

events.title: James Cameron – Challenging the Deep
events.description: This temporary exhibition at the Vasa Museum highlights filmmaker, ocean explorer, and technology innovator James Cameron, combining props from his feature films with film projections and rare objects. Visitors can experience Cameron’s greatest underwater endeavors, both real and fictional. The exhibition is produced by the Australian National Maritime Museum in collaboration with the Avatar Alliance Foundation.

events.title: Wilhelm Kåge & Shōji Hamada – Exhibition at Nationalmuseum
events.description: The exhibition at Nationalmuseum, April 23, 2026 – February 28, 2027, presents two ceramic masters united by a love of form, clay, and glaze. Kåge created beautiful everyday design for Gustavsberg, while Hamada spread the Mingei ideals of handcrafted beauty for all.

events.title: Torsten Andersson – The Weight of Language
events.description: Torsten Andersson’s (1926–2009) oeuvre is unique – with great integrity and a seriousness that today can feel both unfamiliar and longed for, but which also contains a kind of exhilarating joy and sense of space. He painted in large format, distinct, free-standing forms occupy the surface – paintings that are often a kind of depiction of sculptures.

events.title: Live Guided Electric - 1h Sightseeing RIDE
events.description: Join a guided boat tour of Stockholm in a quiet, 100% electric boat and experience the city from the water. Sit back and enjoy the view while the guide tells you about Stockholm’s history, culture, and sights along the way.Onboard, there’s plenty of space and a comfortable atmosphere, and the electric boat makes the tour extra peaceful. You’ll get up close to the city’s quays and islands and receive a relaxed introduction to Stockholm – perfect for those who want to get their bearings and discover new places in a hassle-free way.

venue.name: Vid Gustav III staty, Skeppsbron 2, 111 30 Stockholm

events.organizer: Vid Gustav III staty, Skeppsbron 2, 111 30 Stockholm

events.title: From piggy banks to Swish
events.description: Welcome to an imaginative environment where children and adults can share thoughts about money. In the exhibition, you can discover how views on children and money have changed over the course of a hundred years. Please note that all exhibition signage is in Swedish.

events.title: Water & Light: A Public Photo Installation
events.description: Water & Light is a public photo installation at Vattentorget next to the Golden Bridge (Guldbron) in Slussen. The installation is presented as part of Fotografiska Emerging Artists and brings together four Stockholm-based photographers: Elis Lindsten, Joakim Möller, Sara Herrlander, and Sofia Aedo Zahou. The installation will be inaugurated during the Stockholm Culture Festival and will continue to provide the location with vibrant and artistic content throughout the late summer and autumn.

events.title: Old Town Sightseeing Tour
events.description: Old town, or “Gamla stan” as it is known locally, is by far the most mythical and legendary neighbourhood in all of Stockholm. As the citys historical center, this is where you find out about ancient events and hear fascinating stories and tales that will last for a lifetime! With this tour its like you step in to a time machine and are whisked back to the to middle ages where noblemen, princesses and dukes roamed the streets.

events.title: Play Beyond Play
events.description: The National Museum of Science and Technology has created an experience where you can not only try your favorite games and explore the game history, but also step into, and let yourself be immersed by, games. The Play Beyond Play exhibition occupies over 1,000 square meters of gaming fun! Join in on a journey through game history!

venue.name: The National Museum of Science and Technology

events.organizer: The National Museum of Science and Technology

events.title: Premium Wild Camp Packages
events.description: Go where the wind takes you. With everything you need for an epic multi-day kayak journey. Our wild camping packages include top-quality kayaks, camping gear, and route suggestions, so you can focus on the experience. Paddle across stunning waters, hike scenic islands, and discover the new 270 km Stockholm Archipelago Trail along the way. Choose one of our favorite routes — or create your own custom adventure at your own pace.

events.title: Lola Akinmade Åkerström BookClub Full-day Tour
events.description: Explore Stockholm with the Lola Akinmade Åkerström BookClub Tour. This guided walk highlights Afro-Swedish history, literary sites featured in Lola’s books, and cozy fika stops. Join engaging discussions with fellow readers and support the Afro-Swedish community.

events.title: Kayak & Camping Adventure in the Stockholm Archipelago
events.description: Discover the wonders of the Stockholm Archipelago on a multi-day paddling adventure. Enjoy the simple joy of cooking over a campfire and spend your nights camping beneath the stars. This all-inclusive experience is suitable for both beginners and experienced paddlers, ensuring everyone can enjoy the beauty of the archipelago.

events.title: Sunset Kayak Tour in Central Stockholm
events.description: Explore Stockholm's waterways on a guided kayaking experience, suitable for both beginner and advanced paddlers. Known as the Venice of the North, Stockholm is a city of many canals and stunning waterways, making it a perfect destination for a unique and picturesque kayaking adventure. Capture amazing photos and discover the city from a whole new perspective as you paddle through the calm waters.

venue.name: Stockholm Nature I Kayak & Outdoor Tours

events.organizer: Stockholm Nature I Kayak & Outdoor Tours

events.title: Embraced
events.description: “Embraced” is an exhibition where the viewer not only looks at art, but becomes part of it. Through sculpture, textile, painting, sound, and spatial installations, the body, senses, and presence are activated. Welcome to an immersive art experience featuring contemporary works by Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén, and Anna Nyberg.

events.title: Mother Love
events.description: By August Strindberg, with texts from V. Benedictsson, directed/adapted by Annika Kofoed. Frida Hallgren and Blossom Tainton star in a music theatre show based on Strindberg’s Mother Love. This intense confrontation between a mother and daughter explores the mythical nature of motherhood, blending painful realities with drastic humor. In a fierce clash over dependency, vulnerability, and the longing for genuine connection, past and present blur. Premiere: Sept 5, 2026.

events.title: Superfici Sensibili - ceramics that innovate
events.description: "Superfici Sensibili" at the Italian Cultural Institute explores innovation within the millennial old ceramics medium with illustrations and ceramic objects created by Elena Salmistraro for Bosa Ceramiche. The exhibition is a conversation between material, creativity and culture through ceramic sculptures that explore soul, creation and innovation. Salmistraro's background in pop-art is evident in her ceramics where signs, patterns and color become a narrative structure.

events.title: Oyster Friday at Bonnie's
events.description: Bonnie’s at Bank Hotel welcomes you to Oyster Friday. Every Friday from 4–6 PM, oysters are freshly shucked in the dining room and served at 12 SEK each. Oyster Friday is the perfect way to start the weekend, whether for an after-work, an early dinner, or simply to enjoy the atmosphere and oysters. Welcome to drop in or book your table.

events.title: Åmells art exhibition
events.description: Welcome to an art exhibition in Stockholm, held at Åmells Gallery on Birger Jarlsgatan 14. Every year, they display around ten carefully curated presentations of Scandinavian art for sale. Admission is always free, and information about current and upcoming exhibitions is available on Åmells website.

events.title: Old Town Walk
events.description: Join a 1 hour 45 minute historical walk through Stockholm’s Old Town with a guide company based in Gamla stan. The tour connects royal history, architecture, everyday life and details many visitors pass without noticing, from the Royal Palace to the Rose door and the city’s narrowest alley.

events.title: The Machine's Eye in Human Hands
events.description: A photographer fooled an entire world with fabricated images, an artist invites us to interact with an AI agent trained on her own life, childhood, and heartbreak—and in another project, new, uncanny ecosystems are created as archives and algorithms mutate into new species. In The Machine’s Eye in Human Hands at Fotografiska Stockholm, eight artists come together, each diving deeply into AI in contemporary image-making in entirely different ways.

events.title: Lotta Antonsson – I Am Everything
events.description: One of Sweden’s leading contemporary photographers, Lotta Antonsson, is coming to Fotografiska with I Am Everything. In this exhibition, the artist explores themes of gender, identity, and objectification within a visual world that both unsettles and beautifies. The exhibition moves fluidly between photography, collage, and spatial installations.

events.title: MUCHA – Beyond Art Nouveau
events.description: At the turn of the 20th century, Alphonse Mucha was one of the most famous artists in Europe. A key figure of Art Nouveau and the inventor of an original style of graphic art, his work combined female beauty and stylised nature with a resolutely innovative composition and typography. The “Mucha style” has been a source of fascination ever since it was created and was applied to a variety of artworks and objects that adorned art lovers’ homes around the world at the time. Welcome to an immersive experience for all ages!

events.title: Archipelago Sauna at Skåvsjöholm
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions on the water at Åkersberga, 25 minutes from the city centre. The sauna sits by the jetty looking out over Trälhavet, and it is a short step from bench to water. The sauna is shared with others and sessions run year round, ice or no ice. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: Stockholm Food Tour
events.description: If you want to get the proper introduction to Sweden, this is the tour for you! Using food as the tool for exploring, we introduce you to what the land of ABBA and VOLVO is all about and take you on an exciting walking tour that highlights the foods that are and have been prolific in making Sweden one of the happiest countries in the world.

events.title: Roland S. - friend, client, guest & artist
events.description: Welcome to an exhibition featuring art by Roland Svensson. Roland Svensson (1910-2003) is one of Sweden's foremost artists and is renowned for his depictions of the archipelago. Ersta diakoni's art collection includes his magnificent painting Morgon, commissioned in 1967 for the hospital entrance. The collection also includes a large number of lithographs, several of which were gifts from the artist.

venue.name: Ersta kyrka och Ersta diakoni hotell

events.organizer: Ersta kyrka och Ersta diakoni hotell

events.title: Gamla Stan Walking Tour: Hidden Stories of Stockholm’s Old Town
events.description: Discover Gamla Stan, Stockholm's medieval heart, on a guided walk through alleys and squares where trade, crafts and everyday life once shaped the city. From Slottsbacken to Slussen, hear stories of power, people and hidden corners that bring history to life.

events.title: Stockholm on the Water - Sightseeing Tour on Lake Mälaren
events.description: See Stockholm from its most beautiful angle – the water. This relaxing and inspiring boat tour on Lake Mälaren is the perfect way to experience the city during your visit. As you cruise between historic islands, your guide brings Stockholm’s past to life, telling the story of how a small island settlement grew into one of Scandinavia’s most fascinating capitals. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about the people, events, and everyday life that shaped the city.

events.title: Archipelago Tour by Classic Wooden Boat
events.description: Step aboard a classic wooden boat and set sail on a 1-hour and 45-minute journey through the Stockholm Archipelago. Glide past the Royal Palace, the Opera and the National Museum. Cruise through the Djurgården Canal, admire Fjäderholmen and the cliffs of Södermalm and learn about Stockholm’s rich history from a professional guide.

venue.name: Vid Gustav III:s staty, Skeppsbron 2, 111 30 Stockholm

events.organizer: Vid Gustav III:s staty, Skeppsbron 2, 111 30 Stockholm

events.title: The Carl Eldh Studio Museum
events.description: During the first half of the 20th century, Carl Eldh (1873–1954) was one of Sweden’s most prominent sculptors. His former studio is now a museum with temporary exhibitions, tours and programs.

events.title: Lebohang Kganye – Le Sale ka Kgotso
events.description: Le Sale ka Kgotso is a new exhibition created specifically for Fotografiska by South African artist Lebohang Kganye. The installation brings together photography, sculpture, and scenography, modelled after South Africa’s “Reconstruction and Development Programme” (RDP) houses. Visitors move through rooms that weave together family memories, mythology, and collective stories about home, history, and identity.

events.title: Ballet: Le Corsaire
events.description: Join for a classic ballet tale of passion, jealousy and adventure. Le Corsaire is a full-length ballet in which the Royal Swedish Ballet delivers large ensemble numbers and intimate duets between the pirate Conrad and his beloved Medora.

events.title: My Pink Mind
events.description: In My Pink Mind—their debut exhibition—Blomman Rönnblom draws upon Swedish slöjd and craft traditions, as well as leftist slogans and anti-fascist rallying chants. Through embroidered wall hangings and domestic crafts, the traditional and gender-conservative imagery of old Sweden collides with the very ideologies seeking to overthrow it. Blomman Rönnblom’s artistic practice is characterized by humor, silliness, everyday materials, anarchy, and queer internet culture.

events.title: Courage and Action
events.description: Learn about diplomat Per Anger's efforts to rescue Jews during the Second World War, and meet brave human rights defenders who follow in his footsteps. Closed on sundays.

events.title: Family – for Better or Worse
events.description: The exhibition explores family relationships in art – as both foundation and abyss, as a safe haven and as a perpetual zone of conflict – and shows how artists have worked with the family as a subject. With 49 artists and 81 works, from the late 18th century to the present day, featuring Carl Larsson, Lena Cronqvist, Marianne Lindberg De Geer, Leif Holmstrand, Siri Derkert, Ivar Arosenius, Marie-Louise Ekman, Kayo Mpoyi, Bror Hjorth, Martina Müntzing, Duda Bebek, and Ylva Snöfrid.

events.title: A little corner of Sweden
events.description: The Postal Museum's new exhibition Swedish stamps reflects the country we live in. In recent years alone, you'll find epatraktors, the king, peace symbols, suffrage fighters and many more motifs. Small pictures of Sweden that we then put on our letters, invitations, Christmas cards or small gifts we send to each other. But how are the motifs actually selected? What makes up the picture and how is a stamp designed? You'll find out in the exhibition A Little Corner of Sweden.

events.title: Stockholm Culture Exchange & Make New Friends
events.description: A social gathering where internationals, expats, travelers, and locals come together to meet new people and build meaningful connections in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. The event offers opportunities to discuss culture, travel, languages, and life in Stockholm while enjoying a friendly and inclusive environment. Everyone is welcome, regardless of background or language level. After 10 PM, the evening continues with karaoke for those who would like to sing or simply enjoy the atmosphere

events.title: Paddle!
events.description: In The Swedish National Maritime Museum's new exhibition, Paddle!, you can follow the story of paddling – from historical long-distance journeys to today’s outdoor life – and discover why people are continually drawn to the water. The exhibition engages the whole body. Explore different paddling environments, from forest lakes to the open sea, and experience how paddling can offer both adventure and tranquillity.

events.title: Chiara Bugatti – Horror Vacui
events.description: The exhibition’s title, Horror Vacui, is Latin for “fear of emptiness.” A concept used in both art and physics. The fear of the void is not merely a formal matter. It is urgent: ecological, political. What is feared is not just the emptiness, but the absence of solid ground: a world without guarantees; without a given place to stand; without a natural foundation for belonging.

events.title: Drömlandet – the story of how Sweden became Sweden
events.description: The story of modern Sweden begins with ideas, innovation, and technology. Steelmaking, hydropower, and telephony laid the foundation for industry. Welfare reforms, the contraceptive pill, and parental leave reshaped family life and work. Platforms like Pirate Bay and Spotify transformed the music industry. Follow how a poor agrarian country became a global tech nation – and how the wonders and consequences of technology have shaped society, from politics and trade to culture and everyday life.

events.title: Pippi Longstocking’s world at Livli Shopping Mall
events.description: Step into the wonderful world of Pippi Longstocking this summer at Livli in Kungens Kurva! Fun activities and playful adventures await children of all ages. Capture a memorable photo in Konrad’s Party Sticker Room, jump across the sea on the exciting “floor is lava” challenge, or settle down for a cozy reading moment. Let your imagination run wild and dive straight into Pippi’s colorful world of adventure!

events.title: Vaxholm by Bike & Fika
events.description: Discover Vaxholm at an easy pace on a relaxed guided bike tour through quiet waterfront paths, charming local streets, and hidden corners most visitors miss. Along the way, hear stories about island life and Swedish traditions before pausing for an outdoor fika with coffee, something sweet, and beautiful archipelago views.

events.title: Vaxholm Kayaking & Swedish Fika Tour
events.description: Explore the Stockholm Archipelago by kayak on a guided tour near Vaxholm. Paddle between small islands, red wooden cottages, and historic waterfront scenery while learning about local archipelago life. The tour includes stable sea kayaks, paddling gear, and a traditional Swedish fika served by the water. Suitable for beginners. Departures are also available in German, Spanish, and French.

events.title: Valet är vårt
events.description:
Valet är vårt!
I sommar bjuder biblioteket och Minibladet in barn 6–13 år till aktiviteter om demokrati, nyheter och valet.

Vi startar med vernissage 22 juni kl.16-17 för en utställning där barn lyfter sina egna valfrågor och berättar vad de vill förändra i samhället. Under sommaren kan fler barn skicka in bidrag och bli en del av utställningen. 
I barnens nyhetshörna kan barn läsa anpassade nyheter om valet och samhällsfrågor. Där finns också en tipsrunda och andra aktiviteter som pågår hela sommaren fram till valet i september. Ni kan dessutom tävla och vinna fina priser!

events.title: Rösta på barnens drömbibliotek!
events.description:
Rösta på barnens drömbibliotek!
Nu startar omröstningen där du kan rösta på ritade förslag från barn i åldrarna 6–12 år. Bidragen har samlats in under maj–augusti i år. Kom och titta på alla fantastiska idéer och lägg en röst på det förslag du gillar bäst!
Röstningen pågår från 6 september till och med 31 september under bibliotekets öppettider. Vilket förslag ska vinna tävlingen? Var med och avgör.

events.title: Nordic Tech Week 2026
events.description: Nordic Tech Week is a city-wide tech festival in Stockholm with 300+ independently hosted events, including panels, hackathons, and investor gatherings. The festival brings together founders, startup teams, operators, students, investors, and anyone curious about technology and innovation.

events.title: Nordic Moments
events.description: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum highlights photographic collections in an evolving presentation. The opening exhibition Metamorphoses displays negatives rescued from the project 100,000 Photo Memories, where time and chemistry created new visual expressions. On view from October 17, 2025.

events.title: Nordic Life
events.description: Explore life and people in the Nordic region over 500 years, set against its stunning nature, changing seasons and real-life stories from the Nordiska museet collections and archives.The museum’s largest ever exhibition initiative presents 4,000 artefacts and images in an epic and visual presentation of Nordic cultural history built on the real objects and stories collected by the museum during 150 years.

events.title: September Sessions 2026
events.description: September Sessions is a four-day art festival in Stockholm, initiated in 2023 by Index – The Swedish Contemporary Art Foundation and Mint. While celebrating the diversity of Stockholm’s art scene, September Sessions also serves as a platform for independent curators. Each edition features a specially curated program by an invited curator, temporarily activating the city through projects presented at unique locations.  This year’s curated program leans into emoness, into teenage gloom and late-night moods where intensity, irony, and quiet despair blur together. It stays with that unstable mix of not taking things too seriously while feeling everything too much. Vampires and zombies drift through it, alongside more ethereal presences that soften the edges, holding together fear, humour, pleasure, and a lingering melancholia.

events.title: Run, Plunge & Sauna | Morning Closing Party
Pekboksklubb på Stadsbiblioteket Spelbomskan
events.description:
Välkommen med ditt barn 0-3 år! Tillsammans upptäcker vi böckernas värld!
Kom och ha kul med oss. På Pekboksklubben leker vi fram språkutvecklingen genom att läsa enkla, roliga
småbarnsböcker. Vi ramsar och sjunger tillsammans. 
Kl. 10.00-11.00.
Drop in.

events.title: Mina hjärtefrågor
events.description: Mina hjärtefrågor är en foto- och textutställning av och med Yalla Rinkebys kvinnor. Vad tänker de och vilka känslor väcker det när vi pratar om samhället och demokratin? Vernissage 22 maj på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern Vällingby.

events.title: Språkkafé på engelska
events.description: Vill du öva engelska och lära känna nya vänner? Då är du varmt välkommen till vårt språkkafé på engelska! Vi träffas i grupprummet Romanen.

events.title: Språkcafé på italienska
events.description:
Noi parliamo italiano! 
Kom till biblioteket och prata italienska med nya vänner på fredagar i höst!
Ingen föranmälan men begränsat antal platser.
Observera att språkcaféet vänder sig till dig som redan kan lite italienska och att gruppen saknar samtalsledare.

events.title: Omfamnad
events.description: "Omfamnad" är en utställning där betraktaren inte bara tittar på konst, utan blir en del av den. Genom skulptur, textil, måleri, ljud och rumsliga installationer aktiveras kropp, sinnen och närvaro. Välkommen till en omslutande konstupplevelse med samtida verk av Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén och Anna Nyberg. Visas i Galleri 5 på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern.

events.title: Elisabeth Ohlson – Retrospektiv
events.description: Under mer än fyra decennier kombinerade Elisabeth Ohlson (1961-2024) fotografisk precision med ett samhällskritiskt engagemang. Hennes bilder fortsätter att påverka samtalet om konst, makt och mänskliga rättigheter. Med över 230 fotografier presenteras ett sammanhållet och kompromisslöst konstnärskap. Utställningen visar även den sista bildserien "DÖDEN" där hon inkluderade sin egen bortgång.

events.title: Rum för Minnen
events.description: Mormors kaffekopp, hundens favoritleksak eller din bästa väns handskrivna anteckning. Ett minne kan vara så mycket. "Rum för Minnen" på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern är en rofylld plats dit du kan komma för att tänka på någon som du saknar. Vid utvalda tillfällen arrangeras speciella "minnesceremonier" och med tiden växer en utställning fram i rummet – byggd på besökarnas delade minnen.

events.title: Jérôme Dubois – Immateriell
events.description: I samband med att Jérôme Dubois (FRA) avantgardistiska och färgsprakande serieroman "Immateriell" ges ut på svenska via Lystring förlag visas ett urval av originalteckningar i Serietekets lokaler. Under öppningskvällen den 1 september samtalar Jérôme Dubois om sitt arbete med serieforskaren Robert Aman.

events.title: Barnvagnsbio: Practical Magic - Family Legacy
events.description: Välkommen på barnvagnsbio på Klarabiografen, där vi har valt ut guldkorn ur aktuell filmrepertoar som vi visar med salongen anpassad för dig och din bäbis (men alla är välkomna med eller utan bäbis!). Parkera barnvagnen på entréplan (Plattan), det går bra att ta med barnvagnsinsatsen in i biosalongen.

events.title: PANEL: How to Build a Brand for Growth
Dantes gudomliga komedi
events.description: Endast 4 föreställningar i höst! Världen är en scen, men... Soppteaterns scen är borta. Det står bord överallt. Och bland borden irrar en förvirrad själ. Aha. Det är Dante. Inte ens till mitten hunnen på sin levnads vandring har han gått vilse vid Sergels torg. Niklas Rådström har gjort en smärtsamt underhållande nytolkning av Den Gudomliga Komedin - specialskriven för Andreas T Olsson.

events.title: Konstverkstan
events.description: Konstverkstan är Kulturhusets verkstad där barn och vuxna får möjlighet att skapa, tillsammans eller var för sig. Inspirerade av husets utställningar undersöker vi olika material och tekniker. Konstverkstans mål är att arbeta så mycket som möjligt med återbrukat material från husets olika verkstäder.

events.title: Primetime Husby
events.description: Den flerfaldigt prisade fotografen Alexander Mahmoud ställer ut fotografier tagna under Husbykravallerna i maj 2013. Fotoserien skildrar delar av upploppens förlopp i Husby. Från demonstrationer till bilbränder, kravallpolis och civilsamhällets krafttag för att deskalera våldet. Vernissage 3 september på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern Husby.

events.title: Upploppet
events.description: Upploppet är en teaterföreställning av Murre Gonday och Simon Matiwos, dramatikerna bakom succén 8 kvadrat, om Husbykravallerna 2013. Föreställningen skildrar en familj mitt i händelsernas centrum. I rollerna ser vi Ahmed Berhan, Sharmarke Elmi, Binyam Haile och Segen Tesfai.

events.title: Vem var min pappa?
events.description: "Vem var min pappa?" är en berättelse om föräldraskap, om att försöka förstå sina rötter och en längtan efter att lära känna sin pappa på riktigt. Föreställningen är en monolog av och med Mustafa Zatara, med registöd av Olof Hanson.

events.title: Ny muralmålning i Östberga framtagen av unga
events.description: Fredag den 11 till söndag den 13 september kommer konstnären Sasha Tomasevich  tillsammans med graffitipedagog Tobias Barenthin Lindblad, Östberga bibliotek och unga från Östberga måla en vägg tillsammans.  Motivet är framtaget av besökare på Östbergas fritidsgård, som en del av Östberga biblioteks ungdomsprojekt Hemma i Östberga. Fasaden upplåts av Svenska Bostäder och muralmålningen kommer söndagen den 13 september att kunna ses i sin fulla prakt på Östbergatorget 1 A.

events.title: Da-da-da
events.description: Titta! Lyssna! Känn! För den allra yngsta publiken – bebisarna! Med inspiration från både huvudfotingar och konstens värld träffar vi figurer i välkända situationer. Som att mötas och skiljas, som att dyka upp och försvinna, som att finnas fast inte synas, som att vara nära och isär, som att vilja ha något man inte får och som att få något man inte vill ha.

events.title: Find a Cofounder, Help or Join a Tech Startup
Head to toe
events.description: Konsten vi har gjort är personlig till var och en av oss. Några av våra teman är: könsidentitet, eufori/dysfori, mental ohälsa, autonomi samt många andra känslor/tankar, man får se för sig själv. Med konstnärerna Marta Guiyas Maliik, Isak Hoblyn Gunnarsson, Nikanor Sandoval och Yufan Zheng Yang.

events.title: From Idea to Working Software in One Session
PUNKT.gaming
events.description: Vill du spela tv-spel tillsammans med andra? Varannan fredag kör vi PS5 eller Switch 2 tillsammans i studion på PUNKT.

events.title: Fredagsklubben!
events.description: Specialöppet för dig i mellanstadiet varje fredag. Kom och umgås, läs, spela spel, pyssla... Berätta för oss vad du vill göra! Biblioteket bjuder på fika.

events.title: Hagsätras lite svårare bokklubb
events.description: Hagsätras lite svårare bokklubb är för dig som är 10-13 år gammal, är läsvan, tycker om att läsa och gärna vill träffa andra som läser. Till varje tillfälle läser vi en gemensam bok som vi pratar om. Såklart fikar och pysslar vi också! Vill du vara med? Anmäl dig på biblioteket eller maila till hagsatra.ssb@stockholm.se . Genom att anmäla dig godkänner du att vi sparar din epostadress för att skicka ut information om bokklubben. Du kan när som helst säga till att du vill gå ur klubben eller att du vill få din epostadress borttagen från vår lista.

events.title: Helgpyssel
events.description:
Fredagar och lördagar är bibliotekets aktivitetsrum
öppet för pyssel. 
Alla åldrar är välkomna men yngre barn behöver ha sällskap av en vuxen.

events.title: Fredagsmys
events.description: Fredagsmys på biblioteket för dig som går på lågstadiet. Kom och lyssna på en bok, fika och pyssla lite!

events.title: Primavera
events.description: I 1700-talets Venedig växer Cecilia upp som en begåvad violinist på ett barnhem för flickor. När den karismatiske Antonio Vivaldi anländer som hennes lärare, väcks en ny värld av musik och möjligheter till liv.

events.title: Afternoon Tea i Hedvig
events.description: Välkommen till Afternoon Tea i Hedvig Eleonora församlingssal hösten 2026! Sedan tio år tillbaka har Hedvig Eleonora församling bjudit in till mysigt Afternoon Tea i den vackra församlingssalen på Jungfrugatan 2 på Östermalm. Församlingens Afternoon Tea varannan fredag, har tillsammans med den efterföljande veckovisa allsången inne i kyrkan, blivit ett mycket populärt sätt att påbörja helgen för många människor. Välkommen, träffas och trivs! Hedvigs Afternoon Tea innehåller fyra delar: APERITIF Veckans snittar och bubbel! Olika vid varje tillfälle. TE Planters Ekologiska Earl Grey, ekologisk, Organic Sencha Fukujyu, ekologisk grönt te, samt vår egen populära Hedvig Eleonora sommarblandning. SCONES Husfars hembakta scones med veckans tillbehör såsom lemoncurd, philadelphiaost, samt olika sorters sylt. Olika vid varje tillfälle. DESSERT Veckans hembakta kaka. Olika vid varje tillfälle. BOKNING Platserna släpps onsdagen veckan före respektive Afternoon Te-tillfälle. Du bokar och betalar via Tickster. Pris: 75 kr/person. Begränsat antal platser. Kö tillämpas. Husfar dukar upp Afternoon Tea fredagarna: 11/9, 25/9, 9/10, 23/10 och 6/11 2026, kl. 15.30-17.00. Afternoon Tea-traditionen föddes i det viktorianska Storbritannien i början av 1840-talet. Hertiginnan av Bedford, Anna Russell, lär i smyg ha beställt en kanna te med tilltugg till sitt rum på eftermiddagen då man bara åt frukost och middag. När Anna började bjuda in sina väninnor bland annat drottning Victoria, spreds sig traditionen och gjorde tebjudningarna populära. Sconesen dök upp på 1900-talet. I Hedvig Eleonora församling har det dukats upp Afternoon Tea sedan 2014.

events.title: Sagostund på svenska och persiska
events.description: Varmt välkommen på sagostund som ges på både svenska och persiska! Sagostunden passar barn i åldern 2-6 år men yngre och äldre syskon är också välkomna! Drop in. Ingen föranmälan krävs.

events.title: Filmvisning: Hemlig animé
events.description:
Kom och titta på animé med oss, vi bjuder på dryck och snacks!
Från 7 år.

events.title: Pianokonsert för staden
events.description: Kliv in i en helgjuten musikalisk upplevelse tillägnad Stockholms liv och brus, när pianisten Ștefan Vârtejaru utforskar ett brett repertoarval, inspirerad av stadens rörelser.

events.title: Official Nordic Tech Week Closing Party
Sichuan Mahjong Night: A Classic Chinese Social Game
Art for Industry
events.description:
On September 11, we’re excited to welcome you to the very first event at BAR15, located in the Distriktfem area of Stockholm.

Art for Industry is a gathering at the intersection of art, sound, moving performance, light installations and moving image a space for exchange, experimentation and shared experience. 

The evening opens with an exhibition bringing together Erika Nyberg (Lärkan) mixed-media works and Klas Isaksson paintings on canvas. The exhibition transitions into a film screening by Klas Isaksson and Ellen Benett, before Isaksson extends his artistic practice into an ambient experimental live set. Hara Alonso performance merges electronic composition with a choreographic intervention by Marcos Zoe Nácar, while Clava transforms the space through a site-specific light installation. The evening concludes with two back-to-back DJ sets: Pooja B B2B N.G.L, followed by ogtrues B2B Jessie Granqvist, carrying the night’s journey into its final chapter.

events.title: Live STHLM Johnny Delaware
events.description: {style=text-align:center} En kvällskryssning med livemusik, mat och dryck Johnny Delaware blandar country, rock, pop och latin i ett psykedeliskt Americana-sound. Med hyllade albumet Para Llevar i ryggen kommer han äntligen till Skandinavien i höst. {style=text-align:center} Se menyer och övrig infohttps://blidosundsbolaget.se/fran-stockholm/{class="c-button" target="blank" style=background:F2F0E6;color:312682}

events.title: Svartklubben - Mat & Musik i Mörker
events.description: På den legala Svartklubben får du njuta av läcker mat, specialkomponerad musik och fantastiska sinnesupplevelser. Här får du rika möjligheter att utforska mat, dryck och underhållning på ett nytt sätt! Hur fungerar det att kommunicera utan syn för dig och din grupp? Fascineras av synskadade sjungande servitörer. Utmana dig själv och ät en unik måltid! Det här är garanterat en stark upplevelse med många nya dimensioner. Skrämmande? Ingen fara. Det här mörkret är varmt och välkomnande! Menyn hålls hemlig för att förhöja upplevelsen! - Trerätters. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning och en trerättersmeny. - Trerätters Deluxe. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning, en trerättersmeny med välkomstdrink samt två glas vin/öl, kaffe & dessertvin. - Dryck beställs på plats. OBS! - Om du eller någon i ditt sällskap behöver specialkost kan ni boka det via vår hemsida www.svartklubben.com/specialkost. Detta måste göras senast 24 timmar innan eventet. Tider: Insläppstid: 18:00 Spellängd: 3 tim 30 min Mer info: www.svartklubben.com

events.title: Djungelboken  - The Musical
events.description: ETT HELT GALET DJUNGELÄVENTYR – NU STÖRRE, VILDARE OCH MER SPEKTAKULÄRT! Efter att ha trollbundit över 200.000 besökare är succén tillbaka – större än någonsin! Den 18 april 2026 slår vi upp portarna till det magiska Cirkustältet för en nypremiär du inte får missa. events.title: Stockholm Culture Exchange & Friend Making Meetup
Gästspel: New Nordic Poling (DK m.fl)
events.description: New Nordic Poling (NNP) är en sammanslutning av åtta aktivistiska poledansare som “polar för förändring”. Föreställningen utspelar sig vid NNP:s årliga rekryteringsmöte, där gruppens självgestaltande dokumentärfilm Radikal omfamning visas. Publiken följer med när rörelsen gör banderoller, utmanar Extinction Rebellion till första maj i Köpenhamns sydhamn och reser till Svalbard för att “pole 4 the melting pole” – med sin nya transportabla pole-stång. I ett intimt, lätt interaktivt upplägg – som kombinerar live action med filmvisning – följer publiken NNP:s upp- och nedgångar. NNP undersöker maktstrukturer och planerar happenings, men möter oväntade utmaningar i det aktivistiska grupparbetet. För vad innebär det att praktisera det man predikar? Och hur blir en grupp en rörelse? New Nordic Poling handlar om hopplöshet, kampanda och sökandet efter den (o)möjliga kollektiva meningen. Koncept och regi: Lena Bruun Bondeson Skapad av & på scen: Louisa Yaa Aisin (interdisciplinär & konsult) Lena Bruun Bondeson (regissör & performer) Eng Kai Er (koreograf & powerpointmakare) Adrian Kautsky (performancekonstnär & tekniker) Lara Vejrup Ostan (koreograf) Även skapad av & på film: Anna Kuusamo (skådespelare & performer) Malik Grosos (performer & multimediedesigner) Angelica Stathopoulos (filosof & ordboksförfattare) Videoredigering och affisch: Malik Grosos / Malik Grosos Producent & PR: Lena Bruun Bondeson Med stöd av: Lara Vejrup Ostan Producerad genom kooperativet: KOMMA Performance Productions Med stöd från: Statens Kunstfond, Foreningen af Danske Sceneinstruktører Legat, Copenhagen Municipality’s Performing Arts Committee, The Finnish Cultural Foundation Språk: (bruten) engelska Föreställningslängd ca 2 timmar

events.title: Morbror Vanja & Skogsdemonen
events.description: Den okända första versionen av Tjechovs Morbror Vanja, Skogsdemonen har inspirerat till denna tolkning som även innehåller kärleksbrev mellan Anton Tjechov och Olga Knipper (skådespelerska, gift med Tjechov). Anton Tjechov är närvarande i föreställningen. Handlingen utspelar sig i början av 1910-talet på ett lantgods där Vanja och hans systerdotter Sonja sliter hårt. Deras vardag vänds upp och ner när Sonjas far, den självgode pensionerade professorn Serebrjakov, och hans nya, unga fru Jelena flyttar in. Pjäsen når sin klimax när professorn plötsligt meddelar att han vantrivs på landet. Han vill bosätta sig utomlands med sin fru och behöver pengar för projektet. Han föreslår att man säljer hela godset... Det genomgående temat i Morbror Vanja & Skogsdemonen är livet som passerar utan att man griper tag i det; istället tycker man synd om sig själv, anklagar andra eller ödet och i brist på annan sysselsättning flyter man med, pratar om oväsentliga ting och dricker te eller starkare drycker. Undantaget i personkategorin är Vanjas vän, läkaren Astrov, en visionär som vigt all sin fritid till att rädda skogar från avverkning. Det andra genomgående temat är obesvarad kärlek. Även åtrå dunkar under ytan. På scenen: Rasmus Wessman Agnes Engström Raoul Elebring Lena Ramberg Elias Elkotbi Bo Färjare Irja Torri Tommy Söderlund Jessica Allmo Michael Andersson Miranda Yung Manus: Anton Tjechov, bearbetning av Anna-Maria Ingerö Lots: Anna-Maria Ingerö Teknik: Miranda Yung Affisch: Michael Andersson Speldatum: Fredag 4 september kl 19:00 Lördag 5 september kl 18:00 Söndag 6 september kl 15:00 Fredag 11 september kl 19:00 Lördag 12 september kl 18:00 Föreställningslängd: a. 2 timmar 30 minuter inkl. paus Uppsättningen produceras av Teaterverket i samarbete med ABF Stockholm.

events.title: Mamas Gun | Stockholm
events.description: Mamas Gun kommer till Kollektivet Livet 11 september Sedan debuten Routes to Riches 2009 har det Londonbaserade soulbandet bandet byggt upp ett starkt internationellt följe med sin varma blandning av klassisk soul, R&B och modern popkänsla. Albumet blev en särskild framgång i Japan där gruppen under en period var den mest spelade internationella artisten på radio. Uppföljarna The Life & Soul 2011 och Cheap Hotel 2013 fortsatte att etablera bandet som ett av de mest stilmedvetna soulbanden från Storbritannien. Efter en omstart 2015 tog bandet kontroll över både inspelning och produktion, något som kulminerade i Golden Days 2018 där de fördjupade sitt sound i en mer renodlad 60- och 70-talsinspirerad soultradition. Det kritikerrosade albumet Cure The Jones 2022 anses av många vara deras starkaste hittills och placerades på flera årsbästalistor. Namnet är hämtat från Erykah Badus klassiska album Mama's Gun – en passande referens för ett band som tydligt bär arvet från soulens guldålder vidare. De senaste åren har Mamas Gun fortsatt att växa live, med turnéer i Europa, Asien och USA där deras dynamiska konserter och tajta grooves har gjort dem till ett efterfrågat namn på scener världen över. Den 11 september kommer de till Kollektivet Livet för en kväll fylld av organiska rytmer, själfulla melodier och ett band i toppform. Åldersgräns: 20 år 18 år med förköp. Inför ditt besök på Kollektivet Livet Bar & Scen: Dörrarna öppnas vanligtvis cirka 30-60 minuter före live startar. Observera att starttider alltid är ungefärliga. Våra åldersgränser varierar beroende på evenemangets veckodag, se stadsgardsterminalen.com/faq för vidare information. Evenemangen är stående om inget annat anges då vi har begränsat med sittutrymme.

events.title: Timebar Presents Kadinsky Sessions Amsterdam
events.description:
Timebar
Timebar Presents Kadinsky Sessions Amsterdam
This time, Timebar welcomes the infamous Kadinsky Sessions from Amsterdam for a special night bringing together deep melodic, progressive, organic and indie-infused sounds.
Kadinsky Sessions is a monthly hangout and club night in the heart of Amsterdam, founded by Ras Paulus, Around Us, MC PPHOLL, VJ Gabriel and Host Vinnie. Known for its intimate atmosphere and dedication to progressive house culture, Kadinsky Sessions connects established artists and emerging talent through carefully curated nights.
For this Stockholm edition, expect a journey through deep grooves, melodic landscapes, progressive rhythms and hypnotic energy, with a lineup bringing together artists from both Amsterdam and Stockholm.
Ras Paulus
A longtime figure in Amsterdam’s dance scene, Ras Paulus moved from four decades as MC PPHOLL into DJing, bringing his deep knowledge of the global club scene to the decks. His sets explore deep melodic, progressive and organic house, often with a touch of his signature dubby sound. He is also a co-founder of Kadinsky Sessions.
Around Us
Amsterdam-based progressive house project Around Us has earned international recognition with releases on labels including The Soundgarden, Manual Music, Mango Alley and Magnitude Recordings. Their productions have received support from artists such as Nick Warren, Hernan Cattaneo and Sasha. Behind the project are Jan and Gaby, who also co-founded Kadinsky Sessions.
MC PPHOLL
A true Amsterdam institution, MC PPHOLL has been immersed in house music since 1987 and hosting parties since 1997. With a background in reggae and dub, his minimal, musical approach adds atmosphere and depth without overpowering the DJ. His extensive career includes residencies at Chemistry, TimeMachine and Earth, as well as appearances at Tomorrowland, Awakenings, Mysteryland and countless international stages.
Coralie Llie
French-Swedish DJ and producer Coralie Llie has become a familiar name across Stockholm and Amsterdam’s underground scene, performing around 30 times a year. Her sets move between progressive, organic, melodic, indie and tech house, always driven by emotion and connection with the dancefloor. She has shared lineups with artists including Nick Warren, Jamiie, Franca, Niki Sadeki and Lilly Palmer.
SURFFACE
Stockholm duo SURFFACE blend dark disco, melodic techno, indie dance and deep/progressive house with subtle world influences. With more than two decades of Scandinavian club experience between them, Paul and Anton bring together vinyl roots, tribal energy and sharp musical curation into one deep and soulful sound.
Join us at Timebar for a special Kadinsky Sessions takeover, an intimate meeting of Amsterdam and Stockholm, where deep melodic grooves, progressive sounds and late-night energy come together.
